input.rationale: Section 9 is limited to mutual corporate existence, authority, enforceability and non-conflict warranties (9(a)) plus the Globix acknowledgment (9(b)). Nothing in Sections 1 (HDI's Responsibilities), 5 (Site; Site Management) or elsewhere warrants that the Site, software or hosting/development services will conform to documentation or perform to any standard, and there is no warranty duration or remedy. There is no \"AS IS\" clause or implied-warranty disclaimer, so no carve-out is needed, but the fallback fails on all four material terms (no 90-day software conformance warranty, no 30-day services warranty, no repair/replacement, no refund). We insert the minimal express warranty as new Section 9(c) at the fallback level, expressing the periods as a period of ninety (90) days and thirty (30) days; we do not seek the preferred 12-month/workmanlike/compliance-with-laws/no-malicious-code package.

proposal.summary: Insert Section 9(c): HDI performance warranty for a period of ninety (90) days (Site/software conformity to documentation) and thirty (30) days (services), with repair, replacement or refund.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 warrants only corporate authority, so we have added HDI's express performance warranty as new Section 9(c) at our fallback position: a period of ninety (90) days' conformity to documentation for the Site and software and thirty (30) days for the services, with repair, replacement or refund of the fees paid as our remedy.

ops.text: (c) HDI warrants that (1) for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, the Site and any software delivered hereunder will conform in all material respects to its documentation, and (2) for a period of thirty (30) days following performance, the services will be performed in conformity with this Agreement. For any breach of this warranty, HDI shall, at the Company's election, repair or replace the non-conforming software or services or refund the fees paid for the non-conforming software or services.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
